basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old college student from Toronto, Canada, studying computer science. In my free time, I enjoy playing League of Legends, specifically maining Kog'Maw. My interests include technology, anime, and teaching, which is reflected in the subreddits I frequent. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings between 7 PM to 11 PM EST. I'm currently single and live with two roommates who are also avid gamers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of League of Legends, particularly Kog'Maw, and I'm still learning the intricacies of the game. My knowledge is primarily self-taught through gameplay, watching streams, and reading guides online. I also have a growing interest in teaching, as seen in my involvement with subreddits like CanadianTeachers.
